purpose: Freeze one exact Campaign018 mechanism, direction, source projection, support, missing semantics, overlap challenges, and finite one-trial search before any Campaign018 value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

candidate.name: intraday_range_share_volume_confirmation_240m
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A positive contemporaneous relationship between minute high-low auction width and traded-share participation indicates that price discovery is confirmed by depth rather than generated by thin or stale prints, which may persist over the next three sessions.
candidate.formula: population Pearson correlation Corr(log(high_i/low_i),log1p(volume_i)) across exactly 240 continuous-session bars
formula_steps: Require the exact accepted 241-row source grid, preserve but exclude standalone 09:30, and select exactly the 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00.

Require every selected high, low, and share volume to be finite; require high and low strictly positive, exact raw ordering low_i <= high_i, and volume_i >= 0. Do not round, clamp, repair, impute, or substitute amount.
For each selected bar compute r_i=log(high_i/low_i) and v_i=log1p(volume_i). Exact zero range and exact zero volume remain valid observations in the fixed 240-bar support.

Compute population means, centered sums Srr=sum((r-mean(r))^2), Svv=sum((v-mean(v))^2), and Srv=sum((r-mean(r))*(v-mean(v))). Require every component finite and Srr and Svv strictly positive. No positive-range, nonzero-volume, magnitude, volatility, amount, or activity threshold is allowed.

Compute q=Srv/sqrt(Srr*Svv). If q lies within 1e-12 beyond either mathematical endpoint, canonicalize it to that endpoint; otherwise require q finite and within [-1,1]. Return q without clipping inside the range, winsorization, ranking, weighting, or another normalization.
candidate.timestamp_semantics: Use exactly the fixed 240 continuous-session bars. Exclude standalone 09:30; no adjacent, lunch, overnight, cross-day, cross-stock, or selected-subwindow transition is formed.
candidate.zero_missing_denominator_semantics: Every exact-zero range and volume remains in the fixed support. A stock-day is missing only for invalid/nonfinite input, nonpositive high or low, low>high, negative volume, nonfinite transformed values, zero population variance in either 240-vector, or a correlation outside the endpoint tolerance.
mechanism_distinction_before_values: Campaign018 correlates same-bar intrabar high-low range levels with traded-share levels; the terminal amount-volatility factor correlates destination-bar notional amount with absolute adjacent close returns over 238 within-half transitions.
Campaign018 uses share volume without amount or implied transaction price; Campaign007 correlates adjacent changes in share volume with adjacent changes in amount/volume transaction price.
Campaign018 uses no close, return, open, body, wick, breakout, range-overlap, range-union, range autocorrelation, entropy, cumulative VWAP, market peer, daily price, or forward return.

Holding every high-low range fixed while changing the 240 share-volume allocation can change Campaign018 but leaves every high-low-only Campaign010-017 mechanism unchanged; holding volume fixed while changing range allocation distinguishes it from activity-profile mechanisms.
rejected_variants_before_values: amount, turnover, amount/volume transaction price, raw price level, close return, true range, open-close body, wick, prior-close range, arithmetic high-low width, relative spread other than log(high/low), or volume transforms other than log1p

adjacent changes, lead-lag alignment, within-half-only support, morning/afternoon split, 09:30 inclusion, selected subwindows, market or industry normalization, time weights, range or volume weights, rank correlation, regression beta, cosine similarity, mutual information, or sign agreement
dropping zero-range or zero-volume bars; adding positive-range, nonzero-volume, minimum activity, tick, magnitude, volatility, or liquidity thresholds

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_volatility_coupling_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It pairs absolute adjacent close returns with destination-bar log amount. Campaign018 pairs same-bar high-low range with share volume and reads neither close nor amount.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_share_volume_transaction_price_coupling_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It correlates adjacent share-volume changes with adjacent implied transaction-price changes. Campaign018 uses contemporaneous levels and no transaction price or amount.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_range_participation_entropy_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It measures only the dispersion of normalized range shares. Campaign018 measures cross-variable confirmation between ranges and share participation.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_midrange_width_change_coupling_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It correlates changes in geometric range center with changes in width. Campaign018 discards center and adjacency and instead correlates width levels with share-volume levels.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It is a one-variable notional-amount entropy. Campaign018 uses traded shares and high-low ranges and is a two-variable correlation.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m
